title: Ituro ryahinduye iherezo
intro: Mu minsi ya mbere y’ikiremwamuntu, roho yatangaga impano ifite intego nziza. Nyamara, ishyari ryari mu gicucu cyo kwemerwa. Menya inkuru y’uyu muntu ufite ubwitange n’iherezo ribabaje bitazigera bipfa mu ihishurirwa ry’Imana.
clues: Nari mu gisekuru cya mbere cy’abantu.
Nahaye Umwami wanjye ituro, kandi ryakiriwe neza.
Ituro rya mukuru wanjye ryaranzwe, kandi ishyari ryamugize umwijima mu mutima.
Naramubwiye nti: 'Nurambura ukuboko kwawe unyereke ngo unyice, ntabwo nzarambura ukuboko kwanjye ngo nkwice; mu by'ukuri ntinya Imana, Umwami w'isi yose.'
Nabaye uwahohotewe n'igikorwa cya mbere cy'ubwicanyi ku isi.
Amaraso yanjye yaratakaye, kandi ndi uwa mbere mu bahowe Imana w’umwere.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Igitambo cye cyakiriwe, bituma umuvandimwe we agira ishyari maze yicwa
Yajugunywe mu itanura ry'umuriro ariko asohokamo adakomeretse
Yubatse ubwato bunini cyane ayobowe n'Imana
Yamizwe n'ifi nini maze aguma mu mwijima
Yayoboye ubwoko bwe mu nyanja yari yaragabanutsemo ibice
trial.answer: Igitambo cye cyakiriwe, bituma umuvandimwe we agira ishyari maze yicwa

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Ubwicanyi bwa mbere mu mateka; murumuna we yaciriweho iteka
Yahindutse inkende kubera kurenga ku mategeko
outcome.answer: Ubwicanyi bwa mbere mu mateka; murumuna we yaciriweho iteka

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
